art_direction: 藕粉底橄榄双眼，右眼更眯，微微俯视带点优越感。
composition_variation: Place the eye pair a little above the canvas midpoint. Use two medium-small openings, with the viewer-right upper lid covering roughly two-thirds of its pupil and the left covering half. Keep the pupils aimed straight toward the viewer but slightly lowered, giving a composed assessing look. The left lower contour is fuller and the right lower contour flatter, both entirely organic. Preserve a broad uninterrupted background and let the restrained asymmetry convey mild superiority without a grin or any extra feature.
visible_subject: two eye graphics only; no eyebrows, mouth or head
style_inspiration: Latest user chat image observed locally: a mildly disdainful asymmetric gaze in opaque hand-painted black and cyan eye shapes. Only a written description was transmitted. No chat attachment was uploaded or used as binary input. Earlier eyes-only constraint retained.
visual_review: passed: inspected compressed contact sheet for readable eye expression, coordinated same-color irises, matte curved brush shapes, comfortable pastel background, no added face features, text or watermark
